content.short: Coinalyze provides an advanced cryptocurrency analytics platform.
content.description: Coinalyze is a free, independently owned website dedicated to helping the cryptocurrency trading community by providing research and analytical tools with current data to support informed trading decisions. Designed for traders seeking timely metrics, the platform offers futures market data, including open interest, funding rate, and liquidations, and provides access to hundreds of the top cryptocurrencies for viewing. It focuses on delivering up-to-date information in a straightforward format to facilitate quick assessment of market conditions and asset options.
